acceptanceCriteria: A closed verdict schema (correct|partial|wrong, stubRisk none|boundary|on-path, reason, reviewer) is recorded per (obligation, test example) with reviewer independence checked against the existing exclude-authors record; unknown values are refused.
A configurable agreement policy (default: all K agree correct and none on-path) credits the witness; two agreeing reviewers with no on-path risk credit it.
One partial or one on-path verdict yields HELD with every verdict and reason and the disagreeing axis shown.

Changing the test file blob or cited lines marks verdicts stale and un-credits until re-reviewed; requirements in corvint-tasks-obligation-ledger-v0.md; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1170.
body: GitHub #1170. Crediting an existing test as an obligation witness needs blind independent reviewer judgement; the merge logic (all agree correct, nobody says on-path stub) lives outside Corvint, so held candidates and reasons are invisible. Requested: obligations witness accepts K verdicts per (obligation, example): correct|partial|wrong, stub risk none|boundary|on-path, reason, reviewer identity independent of the author (reuse exclude-authors); credit only when the configured agreement policy holds; held rows keep every verdict and reason with the disagreeing axis; verdicts go stale when the test file or cited lines change.
title: GH #1170: obligations witness: credit existing-test witnesses on K independent reviewer verdicts with an agreement policy; keep held verdicts
